Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> is worrying about her future after failing the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、将来を心配し始めた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>开始担心起了自己的未来。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>開始擔心起了自己的未來。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir échoué à la quête, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a commencé à s'inquiéter pour son avenir.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nach dem Scheitern der Mission begann <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sich Sorgen um ihre Zukunft zu machen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de fallar la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> empezó a preocuparse por su futuro.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> começou a se preocupar com o futuro após falhar na missão.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> เริ่มกังวลเกี่ยวกับอนาคตของเธอหลังจากภารกิจล้มเหลวค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah gagal dalam misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mulai mengkhawatirkan masa depannya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bắt đầu lo lắng về tương lai của mình sau khi thất bại trong nhiệm vụ.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: एक खोज में विफल होने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अपने भविष्य को लेकर चिंतित होने लगी।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: You'll feel better after a good rest.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 一日ゆっくり休めば良くなるよ。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 好好休息一天就会好的。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 好好休息一天就會好的。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Tu te sentiras mieux après une bonne nuit de repos.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Du wirst dich nach einem Tag guter Erholung besser fühlen.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Te sentirás mejor después de un buen descanso.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Você vai se sentir melhor depois de um bom descanso.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: พักผ่อนให้เต็มที่สักวันก็จะดีขึ้นเองค่ะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Kamu akan merasa lebih baik setelah istirahat yang cukup.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Ngươi sẽ cảm thấy tốt hơn sau một ngày nghỉ ngơi thật tốt.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: एक दिन अच्छी तरह आराम करने के बाद तुम बेहतर महसूस करोगे।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Here's a recovery tonic, just for you!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: そんな君のための元気回復剤だ！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 这是特别为你准备的元气恢复剂！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 這是特別為你準備的元氣恢復劑！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Voici un tonique de récupération, juste pour toi !
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Hier ist ein Wiederherstellungstrank, nur für dich!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: ¡Aquí tienes un tónico de recuperación, solo para ti!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Aqui está um tônico de recuperação, só para você!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: นี่คือยาฟื้นฟูกำลังสำหรับเจ้าโดยเฉพาะเลยนะ!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đây là thuốc hồi phục dành riêng cho ngươi đó!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: यह तुम्हारे लिए एक रिकवरी टॉनिक है!

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: For once, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> managed to think positively.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 久しぶりに前向きな精神を発揮してみせる<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>だった。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Pour une fois, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réussi à penser positivement.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Ausnahmsweise gelang es <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, positiv zu denken.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Era <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que por una vez mostraba una actitud positiva.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Era a vez de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mostrar um lado positivo.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> พยายามจะคิดบวกดูบ้าง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba menunjukkan semangat positif untuk pertama kalinya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Hiếm hoi lắm, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mới thể hiện được tinh thần tích cực.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: एक बार के लिए, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> सकारात्मक रूप से सोचने में कामयाब रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: As usual, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> was plagued by pessimistic thoughts.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 相変わらず否定的な見通しばかりだったのは<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>だった。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>果然还是一如既往地充满负面想法。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>果然還是一如既往地充滿負面想法。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Comme d'habitude, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> était en proie à des pensées pessimistes.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Wie üblich wurde <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> von pessimistischen Gedanken geplagt.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Como de costumbre, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> estaba plagada de pensamientos pesimistas.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Como de costume, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> estava atormentada por pensamentos pessimistas.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: เช่นเคย <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> เต็มไปด้วยความคิดในแง่ลบค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Như thường lệ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lại bị ám ảnh bởi những suy nghĩ bi quan.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हमेशा की तरह, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> निराशावादी विचारों से ग्रस्त थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est égayée après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nach Erhalt des Tranks hellte sich <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> auf.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> หน้าตาแจ่มใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับยาค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुश हो गई।
